summary: This is a C# project configuration file that sets up a console application (.NET 8.0) with Oracle database connectivity. It enables modern C# features like implicit usings and nullable reference types, then adds the Oracle data access library as a dependency.

explanations.4: OutputType is set to Exe, meaning this will compile into a standalone executable program rather than a library.
explanations.6: ImplicitUsings automatically includes common namespaces at the top of your files without you having to write using statements, reducing boilerplate.
explanations.7: Nullable enables strict null checking, so the compiler warns you when you might be using a null value unsafely.
explanations.11: PackageReference tells the build system to download and include the Oracle database driver library; Version specifies which release to use.
